## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; mixed signals across sectors with Technology strong but Financials and Energy weak, and leadership concentrated in a few Tech names—supports a neutral stance with no clear market direction.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: NVDA (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +15.84% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY, DD reported bullish catalyst. Industrials gaining: CAT (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +17.44%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Energy weak: XOM (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -3.92% | 1M: -2.02%) BELOW TREND. Communication lagging: CMCSA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.38%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -32.46%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft: JNJ (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +35.14% | 1M: +107.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +34.33% | 1M: +87.23%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.84% | 1M: -4.85%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +15.77% | 1M: +37.20%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration; Style: Growth/Momentum tilt within Tech leaders.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: MO (1W: -6.54% | 1M: +1.83%) CORRECTION, CEG (1W: -6.65% | 1M: +4.60%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -6.81% | 1M: -5.01%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND, TGT (1W: -7.29% | 1M: -2.83%) BELOW TREND — weakness mixed across Consumer Staples, Utilities and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Biggest 1W movers: QCOM (1W: +41.07%), INTC (1W: +35.14%), AMD (1W: +34.33%), LRCX (1W: +14.50%), AMAT (1W: +13.35%) — all showing strong short-term catch-up. Major divergence present: MSFT (1W: -0.23% | 1M: +11.27%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +12.84%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -0.91% | 1M: +6.41%) CORRECTION — tactical caution, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology upbeat on 1W leadership and multiple large-cap semiconductors ABOVE TREND: NVDA (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: -19.61% | 1M: -7.45%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation with concentrated winners; Tech contributes materially to the neutral regime.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials soft on the week with several majors under pressure: JPM (1W: -2.49% | 1M: -3.19%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -0.38%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -0.17%) BELOW TREND — breadth negative and no clear leadership, so Financials are a source of caution.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare lagging with mixed internal signals: UNH (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.32%) ABOVE TREND is a bright spot while JNJ (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -7.14%) BELOW TREND and ISRG (1W: -7.14% | 1M: -6.78%) BELOW TREND weigh on the sector; overall Healthcare shows weakness this week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Remain neutral and selective: favor top Tech/momentum names showing confirmed ABOVE TREND strength (NVDA, QCOM, AMD) and selective Industrials exposure (CAT, BA) while reducing exposure to weak Communication and Energy names (CMCSA, CHTR, COP) given mixed breadth and concentrated leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +35.14% | 1M: +107.50%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +17.44%) ABOVE TREND — momentum and catalysts in semis and Industrials.  
BEARISH: SHOP (1W: -19.61% | 1M: -7.45%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -32.46%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: -10.38%) BELOW TREND — continued downside risk in select high-multiple and Communication names.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology and Industrials (both leading on 1W); breadth support limited so watch dispersion.  
BEARISH: Communication Services and Energy (both showing 1W weakness); Healthcare also to watch for follow-through on recent softness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch retention of 1W momentum in semis (QCOM/AMD/INTC) as trigger for follow-through; A failure of MSFT/AMZN/V to snap out of CORRECTION would signal broader pause; monitor SHOP/CMCSA breakdowns for widening communication weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
PANW (+65): Palo Alto Networks (1W: +15.77% | 1M: +37.20%) ABOVE TREND — analyst upgrades and CEO buying, price action confirms accumulation.  
BA (+60): Boeing (1W: +7.64% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND — China megadeal headlines and price strength confirm.  
CAT (+60): Caterpillar (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +17.44%) ABOVE TREND — Q1 beat and industrial catalysts with confirming price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
NVDA (-40): Nvidia (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines on CEO trip exclusion but price is rising, a divergence to monitor for distribution.  
CEG (-45): Constellation Energy (1W: -6.65% | 1M: +4.60%) CORRECTION — earnings-driven sell-off consistent with bearish news and weakening near-term trend.  
NFLX (-75) is a high negative-sentiment name (news alleging legal risk) — monitor price action vs sentiment for confirmation (price data not in top detail set for trend call here).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given concentrated Tech leadership. NVDA (1W: +10.56% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +12.47%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +41.07% | 1M: +85.48%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence in megacaps (MSFT, AMZN, V in CORRECTION) and narrow leadership raise the odds of rotational volatility — monitor sentiment-price divergences (e.g., NVDA).
